scenarios.title: Verify system meets first acceptance criterion under normal conditions
preconditions: Given first acceptance criterion is configured
And second acceptance criterion is configured
And system is in ready state

steps.action: When user accesses the feature
steps.expectedResult: System displays the feature interface successfully

steps.action: When user performs the primary action
steps.expectedResult: System processes the action without errors

steps.action: Then system validates against first acceptance criterion
steps.expectedResult: First acceptance criterion is satisfied and confirmed

scenarios.expectedResult: System successfully meets first acceptance criterion with valid inputs and normal operation
scenarios.automationHint: Selenium: driver.findElement(By.id('feature-button')).click(); WebDriverWait wait = new WebDriverWait(driver, 10); wait.until(ExpectedConditions.visibilityOfElementLocated(By.className('success-message'))); assert driver.findElement(By.id('ac1-indicator')).getText().equals('Passed');

scenarios.title: Verify system meets second acceptance criterion with valid data
preconditions: Given first acceptance criterion is configured
And second acceptance criterion is configured
And valid test data is available

steps.action: When user initiates the workflow
steps.expectedResult: Workflow starts and displays initial state

steps.action: When user provides valid input data
steps.expectedResult: System accepts and validates the input

steps.action: When user completes the workflow
steps.expectedResult: System processes workflow successfully

steps.action: Then system validates against second acceptance criterion
steps.expectedResult: Second acceptance criterion is satisfied and result is displayed

scenarios.expectedResult: System successfully meets second acceptance criterion with complete workflow execution

scenarios.title: Verify both acceptance criteria are met in end-to-end scenario
preconditions: Given first acceptance criterion is configured
And second acceptance criterion is configured
And system is fully initialized

steps.action: When user executes complete feature flow
steps.expectedResult: System processes all steps in sequence

steps.action: When system validates first acceptance criterion
steps.expectedResult: First criterion passes validation

steps.action: When system validates second acceptance criterion
steps.expectedResult: Second criterion passes validation

steps.action: Then system confirms all acceptance criteria are met
steps.expectedResult: Success message displays confirming both criteria satisfied

scenarios.expectedResult: System successfully meets both acceptance criteria in complete end-to-end execution
scenarios.automationHint: Selenium: Execute full workflow; verify both AC indicators show success state; assert driver.findElements(By.className('ac-passed')).size() == 2;

scenarios.title: Verify system handles invalid input gracefully
preconditions: Given first acceptance criterion is configured
And second acceptance criterion is configured
And system is ready to accept input

steps.action: When user provides invalid input data
steps.expectedResult: System captures the invalid input

steps.action: When system attempts to validate the input
steps.expectedResult: Validation fails and error is detected

steps.action: Then system displays appropriate error message
steps.expectedResult: Clear error message is shown to user

steps.action: And system prevents further processing
steps.expectedResult: Invalid data is not processed or stored

scenarios.expectedResult: System rejects invalid input with clear error message and prevents incorrect data processing

scenarios.title: Verify system behavior when preconditions are not met
preconditions: Given system is in initial state
And acceptance criteria are not yet configured

steps.action: When user attempts to access the feature
steps.expectedResult: System detects missing preconditions

steps.action: Then system displays precondition error message
steps.expectedResult: User sees message indicating prerequisites not met

steps.action: And system blocks feature access
steps.expectedResult: Feature functionality is not accessible

scenarios.expectedResult: System prevents feature access when preconditions are not satisfied and provides clear guidance
scenarios.automationHint: Selenium: Clear precondition flags; attempt feature access; verify error state; assert driver.findElement(By.id('precondition-error')).isDisplayed();

scenarios.title: Verify system handles boundary conditions for acceptance criteria
preconditions: Given first acceptance criterion is configured
And second acceptance criterion is configured
And system supports boundary value testing

steps.action: When user provides minimum valid input value
steps.expectedResult: System accepts the boundary value

steps.action: When system validates against acceptance criteria
steps.expectedResult: Validation passes at minimum boundary

steps.action: When user provides maximum valid input value
steps.expectedResult: System accepts the upper boundary value

steps.action: Then system confirms both boundary values meet criteria
steps.expectedResult: Both minimum and maximum boundaries are validated successfully

scenarios.expectedResult: System correctly handles boundary conditions and validates acceptance criteria at edge values
scenarios.automationHint: Selenium: Test with min/max values; driver.findElement(By.id('input')).sendKeys('0'); verify success; driver.findElement(By.id('input')).clear(); driver.findElement(By.id('input')).sendKeys('999999'); verify success;

scenarios.title: Verify system behavior with empty or null input values
preconditions: Given first acceptance criterion is configured
And second acceptance criterion is configured
And system is ready to process input

steps.action: When user submits empty input field
steps.expectedResult: System detects empty input

steps.action: Then system displays validation error for required field
steps.expectedResult: Error message indicates field cannot be empty

steps.action: And system prevents processing with null values
steps.expectedResult: No data is processed or stored with empty input

scenarios.expectedResult: System properly handles empty and null inputs with appropriate validation messages
scenarios.automationHint: Selenium: driver.findElement(By.id('submit-btn')).click(); assert driver.findElement(By.className('required-error')).isDisplayed(); verify no database changes occurred;
